steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Order. Each energy source is isolated, then verified, then released. A release before verification is flagged.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

findings.title: Release step before verification
findings.fix: Move the release after the verification

findings.title: Energy source with no isolation step
findings.fix: Add the isolation for the source

outcome.notChecked: Whether the step is carried out on the floor.
